title: Field boundaries for Flanders, Belgium (2021)
description: Official field boundaries for approximately 588,000 agricultural parcels in Flanders, Belgium, including parcel specialization typology. Converted to fiboa GeoParquet format from data provided by the Department of Agriculture and Fisheries, with specialization categories including arable farming, horticulture, livestock, and mixed farms.
readme:
## README.md
# Field boundaries for Flanders, Belgium

Provides ca. 588.000 official field boundaries from Flanders in Belgium.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from a file that was provided by the Agentschap Landbouw & Zeevisserij.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Agentschap Landbouw & Zeevisserij](https://landbouwcijfers.vlaanderen.be/open-geodata-landbouwgebruikspercelen)
- **Converted by:** [Matthias Mohr](https://mohr.ws)
- **License:** [Licentie modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik/v1.0](https://data.vlaanderen.be/id/licentie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik/v1.0)

---

- **[Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/be-vlg/be_vlg.parquet)**
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/be-vlg/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/be-vlg/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/be-vlg/be_vlg.pmtiles)

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-08-13 from https://www.landbouwvlaanderen.be/bestanden/gis/Landbouwgebruikspercelen_2023_-_Definitief_(extractie_28-03-2024)_GPKG.zip.
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.6.0.
